features: adds a data-driven Rift Drive gauge, D-to-SS style chain and seven-second Overdrive combat state
adds hit-confirm skill and dodge cancel windows, perfect-dodge rewards and shared cooldown acceleration
adds impact-tier and Drive fields to all five combat actions with runtime validation
adds an adaptive combat render budget for effect count, curve segments, effect layers and floating damage text
adds dynamic VFX quality profiles and layered hit feedback without adding runtime image downloads
adds skill charge and empowered-ready rings, Drive HUD, style rank and richer battlefield depth
adds common panel depth, highlights, shadows, progress markers and diagnostics polish across the UI
preserves Firebase App Check disabled state, Player Save v4, cloud contracts and shared AttackFootprint geometry

assetPolicy.publicPolicy: public/assets contains only manifest-reachable active runtime art, validation summaries and required license notices
assetPolicy.archivePolicy: source blockouts and replaced runtime art remain in art_source and are excluded from GitHub Pages deployment until promoted

verification: release-version validation runs before the main verification chain
v1.10, v1.10.1 and v1.11.0 cumulative validators protect mobile, accessibility, recovery, combat and graphics contracts
all combat actions validate impactTier, driveGain, driveCost and comboWindow fields
TypeScript sources pass the available compiler-based project check with local declaration stubs for unavailable registry packages
active public runtime images and initial-download estimates are unchanged by the programmatic graphics pass
full and patch archives are extracted and compared by SHA-256 against the v1.11.0 working tree
physical Android and iOS FPS, temperature, battery and GPU-memory measurements are not claimed as completed
